features: selfcheck reports the runtime, the binary, the database and the tools
validate accepts the minimal script and rejects an unknown step
plan names each step, the ffmpeg graph and the assets
estimate prices a script from pricing.json without calling a provider
render writes a video for a script that needs no key
the same script, assets and seed render the same frames
verify checks duration, frame count, resolution, audio and title frames
verify names a wrong duration or a missing frame, not a missing tool
a clip smaller or larger than the output fills its scheduled time
a logo with transparency shows the background through it
no command hangs when the caller leaves stdin open
a voice script without a key fails with E_NO_KEY
jobs and ledger read the database without changing it
the four fictional sample projects validate and plan with no key
a name scan keeps company names out of src, schemas, templates, examples and the docs
plan prints the same canonical bytes and planSha256 whatever --now and --seed are
changing one input changes only that step's key and the output's key
a new job with the same paid inputs uses the step cache and adds no ledger line
two renders with every paid step cached write the same file
cache list reads the step cache, and cache prune removes entries only when asked
a result found in another cache folder is copied in without a call or a ledger line
two renders at the same time on one database with two cache folders call a step key once
a removed result is called again and gets its own ledger line, so the ledger equals the reported cost
the model check rejects a call for a stored result, a line without a call and a call without a line
guide prints a short example script that validates and renders with no key and no media files
--help and --version exit 0 with one envelope, and --version reports the version
selfcheck stays ok without Playwright and warns that only screen_recording needs it
the default video is H.264 yuv420p for browsers, and output.encode: lossless keeps exact RGB
brand.font is a font file next to the script, and a font name is refused
captions are drawn only by a from track, one voiceover segment at a time
